  description: |-
    Make daemon startup reconciliation persistence-only so provider recovery is admitted after readiness through the bounded dispatch supervisor. Split durable dispatch creation from provider I/O, require worker-start evidence before provider calls, retain typed dispatch and fence authority for exact cancellation, and keep reaper-stage failures within worker fault scope. Add focused supervision and stale-authority tests.
